&reftitle.description;
public voidIo\Poll\Watcher::modifyEvents arrayevents
Replaces the events the watcher is registered for. The associated data is left unchanged.
This also re-arms a watcher that uses Io\Poll\Event::OneShot and has already been triggered.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws a TypeError if events is empty or contains a value that is not an Io\Poll\Event case.
Throws an Io\Poll\InactiveWatcherException if the watcher is no longer active.
Throws an Io\Poll\FailedWatcherModificationException if the backend rejects the new events, for example when Io\Poll\Event::EdgeTriggered is requested from a backend that does not support it.
